messages:
Devon (PM): Noticed some usability gaps in the new side-by-side regression comparison view for eval runs. Main complaints from beta testers: keyboard nav is awkward, the "pin baseline" affordance is unclear, and the legend colors get lost on dark mode. Can we run through fixes?

Priya (Design): Thanks — good callout. Proposed microchanges: (1) replace "Pin baseline" with "Lock left column" (more discoverable); (2) add a small inline label under the legend saying "Colors indicate change severity"; (3) show a contrast-safe outline on hover/focus for the diff tiles. Mocking now.

Malik (Frontend): Keyboard notes: currently arrow keys move cell focus but not between comparison panes reliably. We should implement roving tabindex across tiles and make the comparison pane behave like a single composite widget with arrow-left/right to switch panes and up/down to move within the pane. Also add a single keystroke "L" to toggle Lock-left.

Lena (A11y): Agree with roving tabindex. Also: each diff tile should have role="button" and aria-pressed toggles when pinned/locked. When focus moves into a tile, we must announce context: e.g. "Tile 3 of 12. Baseline: v1.5 vs Candidate: v1.6. Change severity: moderate." Use aria-live polite for non-interruptive messages.

Theo (Data UX): On the color legend: testers asked for numeric hints next to colors (like "minor (0.1-0.3)"). We can surface a hover tooltip on legend items with the metric ranges. Also consider an alternate pattern (icons + text) for colorblind users.

Priya (Design): I'll add iconography and label variations. Two options: (A) color swatch + icon + label, compact; (B) stacked legend that expands on hover with numeric ranges. Which do folks prefer?

Malik (Frontend): Option A is simplest to ship. Option B needs animation and a11y traps for the hover panel. We can deliver A in patch, iterate to B.

Lena (A11y): For the hover panel in B, ensure keyboard users can open legend extras via Enter/Space and it traps focus. Also provide a persistent "Show numeric ranges" toggle in settings for users who prefer always-visible ranges.

Devon (PM): Prioritize: 1) keyboard roving + role updates, 2) rename + shortcut for lock, 3) legend icons + numeric hover in compact. Sound good?

Priya (Design): Yep. I'll update Figma: added focus outlines, legend compact with icons, and copy update: "Lock left column" + tooltip copy: "Lock left column: keep baseline fixed while you page through candidates. Shortcut: L."

Malik (Frontend): Quick snippet for roving tabindex I want to use:

```
// pseudo
container.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') moveFocus(nextTileInRow);
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') moveFocus(prevTileInRow);
  if (e.key === 'L') toggleLockLeft();
});
```

I'll attach unit tests for focus order and an integration test asserting the aria-live announcement string when focus moves.

Lena (A11y): Announcement wording: "Tile {i} of {n}. Baseline {baselineName} versus candidate {candidateName}. Severity: {low|moderate|high}." Keep it consistent and short. Also include a preference to disable verbose announcements in Settings for power users.

Theo (Data UX): About severity thresholds: we should make tooltip ranges editable in the Run settings and persist per-project. Some teams will want different cutoffs. I'll draft a small settings schema and send it to Priya for copy.

Priya (Design): Copy suggestion for the Lock tooltip: "Lock left column: Keep the baseline fixed while you review candidate outputs. Press L to toggle." For the legend compact label: "Change severity (higher = bigger difference)". Thoughts?

Devon (PM): Good. Also request: when user locks left, clicking a candidate should pin a comment to that pairing (not just the tile). UX should expose "Pin comment to pairing" in the comment menu. Priya please mock.

Priya (Design): Will do. Mock will show comment menu item "Pin to pairing" and visual connector line between baseline and candidate when pinned.

Malik (Frontend): One implementation note: the connector line is SVG overlay. Need to ensure the line doesn't break pointer events and remains accessible (aria-hidden true). We'll add a visually-hidden description for the pairing state on the candidate tile.

Lena (A11y): Ensure the pairing description reads like "Comment pinned between baseline v1.5 and candidate v1.6" for screen reader users. Also ensure contrast for the connector is >=4.5:1 when used as an interactive indicator.

ci-bot: CI: PR checklist - keyboard tests, aria attributes verified, legend icons present. All must pass before merge.

Devon (PM): Okay action items: Priya update mocks; Malik implement roving tabindex and Lock shortcut; Lena to review on PR; Theo to spec editable metric ranges. We'll aim to ship the keyboard + copy changes as a small incremental release, then follow with connector/pinned-comments in next sprint. Thanks! :shipit:
